units.zh: 奸臣上 ○耶律乙辛張孝傑耶律燕哥蕭十三
units.en: Treacherous Ministers, Part 1 ○ Yelü Yixin, Zhang Xiaojie, Yelü Yangge, and Xiao Shisan
units.literal: Treacherous Ministers 1 ○ Yelü Yixin, Zhang Xiaojie, Yelü Yangge, Xiao Shisan

units.zh: 《春秋》褒貶，善惡並書，示勸懲也。
units.en: In the Spring and Autumn Annals, praise and blame appear side by side, and good and evil are recorded together, so that readers may be encouraged or warned.
units.literal: The Spring and Autumn Annals both praise and blame, recording good and evil together, to show encouragement and warning.

units.zh: 故遷、固傳佞幸、酷吏，歐陽修則並奸臣錄之，將俾為君者知所鑒，為臣者知所戒。
units.en: That is why Sima Qian and Ban Gu devoted biographies to flatterers and harsh officials, and why Ouyang Xiu added treacherous ministers as well—so that rulers would know what to heed and ministers what to fear.
units.literal: Therefore Sima Qian and Ban Gu wrote biographies of flatterers and harsh officials; Ouyang Xiu also included treacherous ministers, intending that rulers might know what to take as a mirror and ministers what to take as a warning.

units.zh: 此天地聖賢之心，國家安危之機，治亂之原也。
units.en: Such writing reflects the intent of Heaven, earth, and the sages; it touches the hinge on which a state's safety turns and the root from which order and chaos spring.
units.literal: This is the mind of Heaven and earth and the sages, the pivot of a state's safety and peril, and the source of order and disorder.

units.zh: 遼自耶律乙辛而下，奸臣十人，其敗國皆足以為戒，故列於《傳》。
units.en: Under the Liao, from Yelü Yixin onward there were ten such ministers, each of whose ruinous careers is warning enough to be recorded in the Biographies.
units.literal: From Yelü Yixin downward in Liao there were ten treacherous ministers; each ruined the state in ways sufficient to serve as a warning, and so they are set down in the Biographies.

units.zh: 耶律乙辛，字胡睹袞，五院部人。
units.en: Yelü Yixin, whose courtesy name was Hudugun, came from the Five-Yuan Division.
units.literal: Yelü Yixin, courtesy name Hudugun, was a man of the Five-Yuan Division.

units.zh: 父叠剌，家貧，服用不給，部人號「窮叠剌」。
units.en: His father Yela was so poor that the family could scarcely keep clothed and fed, and their clansmen nicknamed him "Poor Yela."
units.literal: His father Yela was poor and could not supply clothing and food; the people of the division called him "Poor Yela."

units.zh: 初，乙辛母方娠，夜夢手搏羖羊，拔其角尾。
units.en: Before he was born, his mother dreamed that she grappled with a ram and tore off its horns and tail.
units.literal: Earlier, while Yixin's mother was pregnant, she dreamed at night that she wrestled with a ram and pulled off its horns and tail.

units.zh: 既寤占之，術者曰：「此吉兆也。
units.en: On waking she had the dream interpreted, and the diviner said, "This is a fortunate sign.
units.literal: When she awoke she had it divined; the practitioner said, "This is an auspicious omen.

units.zh: 羊去角尾為王字，汝後有子當王。」
units.en: A ram stripped of horn and tail leaves the character for 'king'; you will bear a son who is destined for kingship."
units.literal: When the ram loses horns and tail it forms the character for 'king'; you will later have a son who will become king."

units.zh: 及乙辛生，適在路，無水以浴，回車破轍，忽見湧泉。
units.en: When Yixin was born they were still on the road and had no water for the birth-bath; they turned the cart back, the wheel broke through the track, and a spring suddenly welled up.
units.literal: When Yixin was born they happened to be on the road with no water for bathing; they turned the cart and broke the rut, and suddenly a spring gushed forth.

units.zh: 叠剌自以得子，欲酒以慶，聞酒香，於草棘間得二榼，因祭東焉。
units.en: Yela, overjoyed at having a son, wanted wine for a celebration; catching the scent of wine, he found two jars among the brush and offered sacrifice to the east.
units.literal: Yela, taking himself to have gained a son, wished wine to celebrate; smelling wine, he found two jars among grass and thorns and therefore made offering to the east.

units.zh: 乙辛幼慧黠。
units.en: As a boy Yixin was clever and quick-witted.
units.literal: Yixin in youth was clever and sharp.

units.zh: 嘗牧羊至日昃，叠剌視之，乙辛熟寢。
units.en: Once, while herding sheep until late in the day, he was found by Yela fast asleep.
units.literal: Once he was herding sheep until the sun slanted; Yela went to look and Yixin was sleeping soundly.

units.zh: 叠剌觸之覺，乙辛怒曰：「何遽驚我！
units.en: Yela roused him with a touch, and Yixin snapped, "Why wake me so abruptly!
units.literal: Yela touched him and he awoke; Yixin angrily said, "Why startle me so suddenly!

units.zh: 適夢人手執日月以食我，我已食月，啖日方半而覺，惜不盡食之。」
units.en: I was dreaming that someone was feeding me the sun and moon—I had already swallowed the moon and was halfway through the sun when you woke me. I regret not finishing the meal."
units.literal: I was just dreaming that a person's hand held the sun and moon to feed me; I had already eaten the moon and was halfway through eating the sun when I awoke, regretting that I had not finished eating them."

units.zh: 叠剌自是不令牧羊。
units.en: After that Yela never sent him out to herd sheep again.
units.literal: From then on Yela no longer had him herd sheep.

units.zh: 及長，美風儀，外和內狡。
units.en: When he grew up he had a fine bearing—outwardly mild, inwardly crafty.
units.literal: When he reached maturity he had fine bearing; outwardly mild, inwardly crafty.

units.zh: 重熙中，為文班吏，掌太保印，陪從入宮。
units.en: During the Chongxi era he served as a clerical officer of the Civil Registry, kept the grand preceptor's seal, and accompanied the court into the palace.
units.literal: During Chongxi he served as a clerical officer of the Civil Registry, kept the grand preceptor's seal, and accompanied the court into the palace.

units.zh: 皇后見乙辛詳雅如素宦，令補筆硯吏；
units.en: The empress saw Yixin refined and elegant like a seasoned courtier and ordered him made a brush-and-ink clerk;
units.literal: The empress saw Yixin refined and elegant like a long-serving official and ordered him made a brush-and-ink clerk;

units.zh: 帝亦愛之，累遷護衛太保。
units.en: The emperor also favored him, and he was repeatedly promoted to Guards Commissioner.
units.literal: The emperor also favored him, and he was repeatedly promoted to Guards Commissioner.

units.zh: 道宗即位，以乙辛先朝任使，賜漢人戶四十，同知點檢司事，常召決疑議，升北院同知，歷樞密副使。
units.en: When Emperor Daozong succeeded, Yixin—already a trusted servant of the previous reign—was granted forty Han households, made Associate Commissioner of the Palace Inspection Office, and often summoned to settle doubtful matters. He rose to associate administrator of the Northern Commission and served as associate commissioner of the Commissioner's Office.
units.literal: When Emperor Daozong succeeded, because Yixin had served in the previous reign, he was granted forty Han households, made Associate Commissioner of the Palace Inspection Office, was often summoned to resolve doubtful matters, was raised to associate administrator of the Northern Commission, and served as associate commissioner of the Commissioner's Office.

units.zh: 清寧五年，為南院樞密使，改知北院，封趙王。
units.en: In the fifth year of Qingning he became commissioner of the Southern Commissioner's Office, was transferred to administer the Northern Commission, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Qingning he became commissioner of the Southern Commissioner's Office, was transferred to administer the Northern Commission, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.

units.zh: 九年，耶律仁先為南院樞密使，時駙馬都尉蕭胡睹與重元黨，惡仁先在朝，奏曰：「仁先可任西北路招討使。」
units.en: In the ninth year Yelü Renxian was commissioner of the Southern Commissioner's Office. Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Xiao Huzhu, allied with Chongyuan's faction, hated Renxian's presence at court and memorialized, "Renxian may be appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit."
units.literal: In the ninth year Yelü Renxian was commissioner of the Southern Commissioner's Office. At that time Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Xiao Huzhu was allied with Chongyuan's faction, hated Renxian's presence at court, and memorialized, saying, "Renxian may be appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit."

units.zh: 帝將從之。
units.en: The emperor was inclined to agree.
units.literal: The emperor was about to agree.

units.zh: 乙辛奏曰：「臣新參國政，未知治體。
units.en: Yixin memorialized, "Your servant has newly entered state affairs and does not yet know the principles of governance.
units.literal: Yixin memorialized, saying, "Your servant has newly entered state affairs and does not yet know the principles of governance.

units.zh: 仁先乃先帝舊臣，不可遽離朝廷。」
units.en: Renxian is an old minister of the late emperor and must not be abruptly removed from court."
units.literal: Renxian is an old minister of the late emperor and must not be abruptly removed from court."

units.zh: 帝然之。
units.en: The emperor agreed.
units.literal: The emperor agreed.

units.zh: 重元亂平，拜北院樞密使，進王魏，賜匡時翊聖竭忠平亂功臣。
units.en: After Chongyuan's rebellion was put down, he was appointed commissioner of the Northern Commissioner's Office, advanced to Prince of Wei, and granted the title of merit for aiding the sage, exhausting loyalty, and pacifying rebellion in a time of crisis.
units.literal: When Chongyuan's rebellion was pacified, he was appointed commissioner of the Northern Commissioner's Office, advanced to Prince of Wei, and granted the title of merit for aiding the sage, exhausting loyalty, and pacifying rebellion in a time of crisis.

units.zh: 咸雍五年，加守太師。
units.en: In the fifth year of Xianyong he was given the added rank of Defender Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Xianyong he was given the added rank of Defender Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 詔四方有軍旅，許以便宜從事，勢震中外，門下饋賂不絕。
units.en: An edict allowed him, wherever military affairs arose in the four quarters, to act at discretion. His power shook court and countryside alike, and gifts at his gate never ceased.
units.literal: An edict allowed him, wherever there were military affairs in the four quarters, to act at discretion; his power shook court and countryside alike, and gifts at his gate never ceased.

units.zh: 凡阿順者蒙薦擢，忠直者被斥竄。
units.en: All who flattered him won promotion; the loyal and upright were driven out.
units.literal: All who flattered him won promotion; the loyal and upright were driven out.

units.zh: 大康元年，皇太子始預朝政，法度修明。
units.en: In the first year of the Dakang era, the crown prince began to take part in government, and regulations were enforced with new rigor.
units.literal: In the first year of Dakang, the crown prince first took part in court government, and laws and standards were put in good order.

units.zh: 乙辛不得逞，謀以事誣皇后。
units.en: Unable to have his way, Yixin plotted to frame the empress on a false charge.
units.literal: Yixin could not have his way and plotted to frame the empress on a charge.

units.zh: 后既死，乙辛不自安，又欲害太子。
units.en: Once the empress was dead, Yixin grew uneasy and turned his mind again to destroying the crown prince.
units.literal: After the empress died, Yixin was ill at ease and again wished to harm the crown prince.

units.zh: 乘間入奏曰：「帝與后如天地並位，中宮豈可曠？」
units.en: Seizing a moment to address the throne, he said, "Emperor and empress stand together like Heaven and earth—how can the inner palace be left vacant?"
units.literal: Seizing an opportunity he entered and memorialized, saying, "Emperor and empress stand like Heaven and earth side by side—how can the inner palace stand empty?"

units.zh: 盛稱其黨駙馬都尉蕭霞抹之妹美而賢。
units.en: He then spoke at length of the beauty and virtue of the sister of his ally, Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Xiao Xiamo.
units.literal: He lavishly praised the sister of his partisan, Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Xiao Xiamo, as beautiful and worthy.

units.zh: 上信之，納於宮，尋冊為皇后。
units.en: The emperor believed him, brought the woman into the palace, and soon installed her as empress.
units.literal: The emperor believed him, took her into the palace, and soon enfeoffed her as empress.

units.zh: 時護衛蕭忽古知乙辛奸狀，伏橋下，欲殺之。
units.en: The guardsman Xiao Hugu, who knew Yixin's treachery, lay in ambush beneath a bridge intending to kill him.
units.literal: At that time the guardsman Xiao Hugu knew Yixin's treacherous conduct, lay in wait under a bridge, and wished to kill him.

units.zh: 俄暴雨壞橋，謀不遂。
units.en: A sudden downpour wrecked the bridge, and the plot came to nothing.
units.literal: Soon a violent rainstorm destroyed the bridge, and the plot did not succeed.

units.zh: 林牙蕭巖壽密奏曰：「乙辛自皇太子預政，內懷疑懼，又與宰相張孝傑相附會。
units.en: Palace Secretary Xiao Yanshou submitted a secret memorial: "Ever since the crown prince entered government, Yixin has been inwardly fearful, and he has been in league with Chief Minister Zhang Xiaojie.
units.literal: Palace Secretary Xiao Yanshou secretly memorialized, saying, "Since the crown prince began to share in government, Yixin has harbored suspicion and fear within, and moreover he has joined forces with the chief minister Zhang Xiaojie.

units.zh: 恐有異圖，不可使居要地。」
units.en: I fear he harbors ulterior designs; he must not be left in a position of power."
units.literal: I fear he has ulterior designs and he must not be allowed to hold a crucial post."

units.zh: 出為中京留守。
units.en: Yixin was transferred out to serve as Military Governor of the Central Capital.
units.literal: He was sent out as Military Governor of the Central Capital.

units.zh: 乙辛泣謂人曰：「乙辛無過，因讒見出。」
units.en: Yixin wept and told others, "I have done nothing wrong; it is slander that has driven me out."
units.literal: Yixin wept and said to others, "Yixin has no fault; it is because of slander that I have been sent out."

units.zh: 其黨蕭霞抹輩以其言聞於上。
units.en: His partisans, including Xiao Xiamo, repeated these words to the emperor.
units.literal: His partisans Xiao Xiamo and the like reported his words to the emperor.

units.zh: 上悔之。
units.en: The emperor came to regret the decision.
units.literal: The emperor regretted it.

units.zh: 無何，出蕭巖壽為順義軍節度使，詔近臣議召乙辛事。
units.en: Before long Xiao Yanshou was posted away as Military Commissioner of the Shunyi Army, and the emperor ordered his close advisers to deliberate on recalling Yixin.
units.literal: Before long, Xiao Yanshou was sent out as Military Commissioner of the Shunyi Army, and an edict ordered close ministers to discuss recalling Yixin.

units.zh: 北面官屬無敢言者，耶律撒剌曰：「初以蕭巖壽奏出乙辛，若所言不當，宜坐以罪，若當，則不可復召。」
units.en: None of the Northern Court officials dared speak up until Yelü Sala said, "Yixin was removed on Xiao Yanshou's memorial. If that memorial was wrong, Yanshou should be punished; if it was right, Yixin must not be brought back."
units.literal: Among the Northern Court officials none dared speak; Yelü Sala said, "At first Yixin was sent out on Xiao Yanshou's memorial—if what he said was improper, he should be punished for a crime; if it was proper, then Yixin must not be recalled."

units.zh: 累諫不從。
units.en: He remonstrated again and again, but the emperor would not listen.
units.literal: He remonstrated repeatedly but was not heeded.

units.zh: 乃復召為北院樞密使。
units.en: Yixin was nevertheless recalled and reappointed Commissioner of the Northern Commissioner's Office.
units.literal: Yixin was then recalled and made Commissioner of the Northern Commissioner's Office.

units.zh: 時皇太子以母後之故，憂見顏色。
units.en: The crown prince, grieving his mother's death, wore sorrow plain on his face.
units.literal: At that time the crown prince, on account of his mother's death, showed grief in his countenance.

units.zh: 乙辛黨欣躍相慶，讒謗沸騰，忠良之士，斥逐殆盡。
units.en: Yixin's faction rejoiced openly while slander swirled through the court and loyal officials were driven out almost to a man.
units.literal: Yixin's faction leaped for joy and congratulated one another; slander boiled over, and loyal and good men were driven out almost to the last man.

units.zh: 乙辛因蕭十三之言，夜召蕭得裏特謀構太子，令護衛太保耶律查剌誣告耶律撒剌等同謀立皇太子。
units.en: Acting on Xiao Shisan's counsel, Yixin summoned Xiao Delite by night to plot against the crown prince and had Guards Commissioner Yelü Chala accuse Yelü Sala and others of conspiring to put the prince on the throne.
units.literal: On Xiao Shisan's words, Yixin by night summoned Xiao Delite to plot framing the crown prince, and ordered Guards Commissioner Yelü Chala to lodge a false accusation that Yelü Sala and others had conspired to install the crown prince.

units.zh: 詔按無跡而罷。
units.en: An investigation ordered by edict found no evidence, and the case was dropped.
units.literal: An edict ordered investigation; no trace was found and the matter was dropped.

units.zh: 又令牌印郎君蕭訛都斡詣上誣首：「耶律查剌前告耶律撒剌等事皆實，臣亦與其謀。
units.en: He then had Seal-and-Token Gentleman Xiao Eduo appear before the throne with a fabricated confession: "Yelü Chala's earlier charge against Yelü Sala and the others was true, and I was party to the plot as well.
units.literal: He again ordered Seal-and-Token Gentleman Xiao Eduo to go before the emperor with a false confession: "Yelü Chala's earlier accusation against Yelü Sala and the rest was all true, and I too took part in the plot.

units.zh: 本欲殺乙辛等而立太子。
units.en: Our plan was to kill Yixin and his faction and set up the crown prince.
units.literal: We originally intended to kill Yixin and the rest and establish the crown prince.

units.zh: 臣等若不言，恐事白連坐。」
units.en: If we kept silent, we feared we would be punished together once the plot was exposed."
units.literal: If we ministers did not speak, I feared that when the affair came to light we would be implicated together."

units.zh: 詔使鞫劾，乙辛迫令具伏。
units.en: The emperor ordered an inquiry, and Yixin tortured the accused until they confessed.
units.literal: An edict ordered interrogation; Yixin forced them to confess in full.

units.zh: 上怒，命誅撒剌及速撒等。
units.en: Enraged, the emperor ordered Sala, Susa, and the others put to death.
units.literal: The emperor was enraged and ordered the execution of Sala, Susa, and the rest.

units.zh: 乙辛恐帝疑，引數人庭詰，各令荷重校，繩系其頸，不能出氣，人人不堪其酷，惟求速死。
units.en: Fearing the emperor's doubts, Yixin had several men questioned in the courtyard, loaded with heavy cangues and ropes drawn tight about their necks until they could scarcely breathe; broken by the torment, each man begged only for a swift death.
units.literal: Yixin feared the emperor's doubts; he brought several men into the courtyard for questioning, had each bear heavy cangues, and bound ropes about their necks so they could not breathe; every man could not endure the cruelty and only begged to die quickly.

units.zh: 反奏曰：「別無異辭。」
units.en: He then reported back, "They have nothing further to say."
units.literal: He instead memorialized, saying, "There is no other testimony."

units.zh: 時方暑，屍不得瘞，以至地臭。
units.en: It was high summer, and the bodies could not be buried in time; the stench filled the ground.
units.literal: It was then midsummer; the corpses could not be buried, until the ground reeked.

units.zh: 乃囚皇太子於上京，監衛者皆其黨。
units.en: The crown prince was imprisoned at the Supreme Capital under guards who were all Yixin's men.
units.literal: The crown prince was then imprisoned at the Supreme Capital; all the supervising guards were his partisans.

units.zh: 尋遣蕭達魯古、撒把害太子。
units.en: Soon afterward Xiao Dalugu and Saba were dispatched to murder the crown prince.
units.literal: Soon Xiao Dalugu and Saba were sent to harm the crown prince.

units.zh: 乙辛黨大喜，聚飲數日。
units.en: Yixin's faction celebrated with feasting that lasted for days.
units.literal: Yixin's faction was greatly pleased and gathered to drink for several days.

units.zh: 上京留守蕭撻得以卒聞。
units.en: Xiao Tade, Military Governor of the Supreme Capital, was able to report the prince's death in detail.
units.literal: The Military Governor of the Supreme Capital, Xiao Tade, was able to report the death in full.

units.zh: 上哀悼，欲召其妻，乙辛陰遣人殺之，以滅其口。
units.en: The emperor mourned and wished to summon the prince's wife, but Yixin secretly had her killed to silence anyone who might speak.
units.literal: The emperor mourned and wished to summon the prince's wife; Yixin secretly sent men to kill her, to silence witnesses.

units.zh: 五年正月，上將出獵，乙辛奏留皇孫，上欲從之。
units.en: In the first month of the fifth year, as the emperor prepared to go hunting, Yixin asked that the imperial grandson be left behind, and the emperor was inclined to agree.
units.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, when the emperor was about to go hunting, Yixin memorialized to keep the imperial grandson behind; the emperor wished to agree.

units.zh: 同知點檢蕭兀納諫曰：「陛下若從乙辛留皇孫，皇孫尚幼，左右無人，願留臣保護，以防不測。」
units.en: Associate Commissioner of the Palace Inspection Office Xiao Wuna remonstrated: "If Your Majesty leaves the grandson behind as Yixin wishes, he is still a child with no one trustworthy at his side. Allow me to stay and guard him against mishap."
units.literal: Associate Commissioner of the Palace Inspection Office Xiao Wuna remonstrated, saying, "If Your Majesty follows Yixin in keeping the imperial grandson, the grandson is still young and will have no one at his side; I beg to remain to protect him, to guard against the unforeseen."

units.zh: 遂與皇孫俱行。
units.en: The emperor took the grandson with him on the hunt.
units.literal: He then went together with the imperial grandson.

units.zh: 由是上始疑乙辛，頗知其奸。
units.en: From this the emperor first began to suspect Yixin and to see something of his treachery.
units.literal: From this the emperor first grew suspicious of Yixin and came to know his treachery fairly well.

units.zh: 會北幸，將次黑山之平澱，上適見扈從官屬多隨乙辛後，惡之，出乙辛知南院大王事。
units.en: On a tour of the north, as the court was about to encamp at the Pingdian ford on Black Mountain, the emperor noticed how many attendants trailed behind Yixin and took offense; Yixin was transferred to the post of Grand Prince of the Southern Commission.
units.literal: When the emperor was on a northern tour and was about to halt at the Pingdian of Black Mountain, he happened to see that many of the attendant officials followed behind Yixin; he disliked this and sent Yixin out to serve as Grand Prince of the Southern Commission.

units.zh: 及例削一字王爵，改王混同，意稍自安。
units.en: When, by the usual rule, one character was stripped from his princely title and he was redesignated Prince of Huntong, he felt somewhat reassured.
units.literal: When by precedent one character was cut from his princely title and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Huntong, his mind grew somewhat at ease.

units.zh: 及赴闕入謝，帝即日遣還，改知興中府事。
units.en: When he came to court to offer thanks, the emperor sent him back the same day and reassigned him as Administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
units.literal: When he came to the capital to enter thanks, the emperor that same day sent him back and changed his appointment to Administrator of the Xingzhong Prefecture.

units.zh: 七年冬，坐以禁物鬻入外國，下有司議，法當死。
units.en: In the winter of the seventh year he was convicted of selling contraband abroad; the case was referred to the judicial offices, and the statute called for death.
units.literal: In the winter of the seventh year he was charged with selling forbidden goods into foreign states; the matter was referred to the relevant offices for deliberation, and by law he should die.

units.zh: 乙辛黨耶律燕哥獨奏當入八議，得減死論，擊以鐵骨朵，幽於來州。
units.en: Yixin's ally Yelü Yangge alone argued that the Eight Deliberations should apply; the sentence was reduced from death, Yixin was beaten with the iron mace, and imprisoned at Laizhou.
units.literal: Yixin's partisan Yelü Yangge alone memorialized that he should enter the Eight Deliberations, and a reduced sentence from death was obtained; he was struck with the iron mace and confined at Laizhou.

units.zh: 後謀奔宋及私藏兵甲事覺，縊殺之。
units.en: Later, when his plot to flee to Song and his secret store of arms were discovered, he was strangled.
units.literal: Later his plot to flee to Song and his private hoard of weapons and armor came to light, and he was strangled to death.

units.zh: 乾統二年，發冢，戮其屍。
units.en: In the second year of Qiantong his tomb was opened and his corpse was publicly shamed.
units.literal: In the second year of Qiantong his tomb was opened and his corpse was disgraced.

units.zh: 張孝傑，建州永霸縣人。
units.en: Zhang Xiaojie was a native of Yongba County in Jianzhou.
units.literal: Zhang Xiaojie was a native of Yongba County in Jianzhou.

units.zh: 家貧，好學。
units.en: His family was poor, but he loved learning.
units.literal: His family was poor, but he loved learning.

units.zh: 重熙二十四年，擢進士第一。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year of Chongxi he placed first in the jinshi examinations.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Chongxi he was promoted first in the jinshi examinations.

units.zh: 清寧間，累遷樞密直學士。
units.en: During the Qingning era he was repeatedly promoted to Direct Academician of the Commissioner's Office.
units.literal: During Qingning he was repeatedly promoted to Direct Academician of the Commissioner's Office.

units.zh: 咸雍初，坐誤奏事，出為惠州刺史。
units.en: At the beginning of the Xianyong era, for a mistaken memorial he was sent out as Prefect of Huizhou.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong, for a mistaken memorial he was sent out as Prefect of Huizhou.

units.zh: 俄召復舊職，兼知戶部司事。
units.en: Soon he was recalled to his former post and concurrently directed Revenue Bureau affairs.
units.literal: Soon he was recalled to his former post and concurrently directed Revenue Bureau affairs.

units.zh: 三年，參知政事，同知樞密院事，加工部侍郎。
units.en: In the third year he became associate participant in governance, associate administrator of the Commissioner's Office, and supplemental Vice Minister of Works.
units.literal: In the third year he became associate participant in governance, associate administrator of the Commissioner's Office, and supplemental Vice Minister of Works.

units.zh: 八年，封陳國公。
units.en: In the eighth year he was enfeoffed as Duke of Chen.
units.literal: In the eighth year he was enfeoffed as Duke of Chen.

units.zh: 上以孝傑勤幹，數問以事，為北府宰相。
units.en: Because the emperor found Xiaojie diligent and capable and often consulted him on affairs, he became chancellor of the Northern Commission.
units.literal: Because the emperor found Xiaojie diligent and capable and often consulted him on affairs, he became chancellor of the Northern Commission.

units.zh: 漢人貴幸無比。
units.en: No Han subject had ever enjoyed such favor.
units.literal: No Han subject had ever enjoyed such favor.

units.zh: 大康元年，賜國姓。
units.en: In the first year of the Dakang era he was granted the imperial clan surname.
units.literal: In the first year of Dakang he was granted the imperial clan surname.

units.zh: 明年秋獵，帝一日射鹿三十，燕從官。
units.en: The next year during the autumn hunt the emperor shot thirty deer in a single day and feasted his attendants.
units.literal: The next year during the autumn hunt the emperor shot thirty deer in a single day and feasted his attendants.

units.zh: 酒酣，命賦《雲上於天詩》，詔孝傑坐禦榻旁。
units.en: When the wine was deep he ordered a composition of the "Clouds Rising to Heaven" poem and had Xiaojie seated beside the imperial couch.
units.literal: When the wine was deep he ordered a composition of the "Clouds Rising to Heaven" poem and had Xiaojie seated beside the imperial couch.

units.zh: 上誦《黍離》詩：「知我者謂我心憂，不知我者謂我何求。」
units.en: The emperor recited the Shu Li poem: "Those who know me say my heart is troubled; those who do not know me ask what I seek."
units.literal: The emperor recited the Shu Li poem: "Those who know me say my heart is troubled; those who do not know me ask what I seek."

units.zh: 孝傑奏曰：「今天下太平，陛下何憂？
units.en: Xiaojie memorialized, "All under Heaven is at peace today—what does Your Majesty have to worry about?
units.literal: Xiaojie memorialized, saying, "All under Heaven is at peace today—what does Your Majesty have to worry about?

units.zh: 富有四海，陛下何求？」
units.en: You possess the four seas—what does Your Majesty still seek?"
units.literal: You possess the four seas—what does Your Majesty still seek?"

units.zh: 帝大悅。
units.en: The emperor was greatly pleased.
units.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased.

units.zh: 三年，群臣侍燕，上曰：「先帝用仁先、化葛，以賢智也。
units.en: In the third year, as the hundred officials attended a banquet, the emperor said, "The late emperor employed Renxian and Huage for their wisdom and talent.
units.literal: In the third year, as the hundred officials attended a banquet, the emperor said, "The late emperor employed Renxian and Huage for their wisdom and talent.

units.zh: 朕有孝傑、乙辛，不在仁先、化葛下，誠為得人。」
units.en: I have Xiaojie and Yixin, who are no inferior to Renxian and Huage—truly I have found capable men."
units.literal: I have Xiaojie and Yixin, who are no inferior to Renxian and Huage—truly I have found capable men."

units.zh: 歡飲至夜，乃罷。
units.en: They drank in joy until night before dispersing.
units.literal: They drank in joy until night before dispersing.

units.zh: 是年夏，乙辛譖皇太子，孝傑同力相濟。
units.en: That summer, when Yixin slandered the crown prince, Xiaojie worked hand in hand with him.
units.literal: That summer Yixin slandered the crown prince, and Xiaojie lent his strength in mutual support.

units.zh: 及乙辛受詔按皇太子黨人，誣害忠良，孝傑之謀居多。
units.en: When Yixin was ordered to investigate the crown prince's supposed faction and framed loyal men, most of the plotting came from Xiaojie.
units.literal: When Yixin received the edict to investigate the crown prince's partisans and falsely harmed the loyal and good, Xiaojie's schemes made up the greater part.

units.zh: 乙辛薦孝傑忠於社稷，帝謂孝傑可比狄仁傑，賜名仁傑，乃許放海東青鶻。
units.en: Yixin praised Xiaojie as loyal to the realm; the emperor compared him to Di Renjie, granted him the name Renjie, and allowed the eastern-sea green falcon to be sent forth.
units.literal: Yixin recommended Xiaojie as loyal to the altars of state; the emperor said Xiaojie could be compared to Di Renjie, bestowed the name Renjie, and then permitted the release of the eastern-sea green falcon.

units.zh: 六年，既出乙辛，上亦悟孝傑奸佞，尋出為武定軍節度使。
units.en: In the sixth year, once Yixin had been removed, the emperor also saw through Xiaojie's treachery and soon posted him away as Military Commissioner of the Wuding Army.
units.literal: In the sixth year, after Yixin had been sent out, the emperor also perceived Xiaojie's treachery and flattery, and soon sent him out as Military Commissioner of the Wuding Army.

units.zh: 坐私販廣濟湖鹽及擅改詔旨，削爵，貶安肅州，數年乃歸。
units.en: Convicted of smuggling salt from Guangji Lake and altering an imperial edict on his own authority, he was stripped of rank, banished to Ansu Prefecture, and allowed to return only years later.
units.literal: He was charged with privately trafficking salt from Guangji Lake and altering an edict on his own authority; his noble rank was stripped, he was demoted to Ansu Prefecture, and only after several years did he return.

units.zh: 大安中，死於鄉。
units.en: He died at home during the Da'an era.
units.literal: In the Da'an era he died in his native place.

units.zh: 乾統初，剖棺戮屍，以族產分賜臣下。
units.en: Early in Qiantong his coffin was opened and his corpse shamed, and his family's property was divided among officials as gifts.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qiantong his coffin was opened and his corpse disgraced, and his clan property was divided and bestowed on subordinates.

units.zh: 孝傑久在相位，貪貨無厭，時與親戚會飲，嘗曰：「無百萬兩黃金，不足為宰相家。」
units.en: Xiaojie had long held the chancellorship and was insatiably greedy for wealth; drinking with his kinsmen he once remarked, "A million taels of gold is the least a chancellor's household deserves."
units.literal: Xiaojie long held the chancellorship, greedy for goods without satiety; he would meet with kinsmen to drink and once said, "Without a million taels of gold one is not fit to be a chancellor's household."

units.zh: 初，孝傑及第，詣佛寺，忽迅風吹孝傑襆頭，與浮圖齊，墜地而碎。
units.en: When he first passed the examinations he visited a Buddhist temple; a sudden gust lifted his cap level with the pagoda, then dashed it to the ground where it shattered.
units.literal: Earlier, when Xiaojie passed the examinations, he visited a Buddhist temple; suddenly a swift wind blew Xiaojie's headwrap level with the pagoda; it fell to the ground and shattered.

units.zh: 有老僧曰：「此人必驟貴，然亦不得其死。」
units.en: An old monk said, "This man will rise swiftly to power, but he will not die a natural death."
units.literal: An old monk said, "This man will surely rise swiftly to high rank, yet he will also not die a natural death."

units.zh: 竟如其言。
units.en: In the end it happened just as he had said.
units.literal: In the end it was exactly as he said.

units.zh: 耶律燕哥，字善寧，季父房之後。
units.en: Yelü Yangge, whose courtesy name was Shaning, was descended from the Lesser Father House.
units.literal: Yelü Yangge, courtesy name Shaning, was a descendant of the Lesser Father House.

units.zh: 四世祖鐸穩，太祖異母弟。
units.en: His fourth-generation ancestor Duowen was a younger half-brother of Emperor Taizu.
units.literal: His fourth-generation ancestor Duowen was the Taizu Emperor's younger half-brother.

units.zh: 父曰豁裏斯，官至太師。
units.en: His father Huolisi rose to the rank of Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: His father, named Huolisi, reached the office of Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 燕哥狡佞而敏。
units.en: Yangge was cunning, fawning, and quick-witted.
units.literal: Yangge was crafty, fawning, and quick.

units.zh: 清寧間，為左護衛太保。
units.en: During the Qingning era he served as Left Guards Commissioner.
units.literal: During Qingning he served as Left Guards Commissioner.

units.zh: 大康初，轉北面林牙。
units.en: At the start of the Dakang era he was made Northern Palace Secretary.
units.literal: At the beginning of Dakang he was transferred to Northern Palace Secretary.

units.zh: 初，耶律乙辛自中京留守復為樞密使，以燕哥為耳目，凡聞見必以告。
units.en: When Yelü Yixin returned from the Central Capital to the Commissioner's Office, he used Yangge as his eyes and ears, reporting everything he heard or saw.
units.literal: Earlier, when Yelü Yixin returned from Military Governor of the Central Capital to Commissioner of the Commissioner's Office, he used Yangge as eyes and ears; whatever he heard or saw he always reported.

units.zh: 乙辛愛而薦之，帝亦以為賢，拜左夷離畢。
units.en: Yixin favored and recommended him; the emperor too judged him worthy and appointed him Left Yilibi.
units.literal: Yixin favored him and recommended him; the emperor also considered him worthy and appointed him Left Yilibi.

units.zh: 及皇太子被誣，帝遣燕哥往訊之，太子謂燕哥曰：「帝惟我一子，今為儲嗣，復何求，敢為此事！
units.en: When the crown prince was framed, the emperor sent Yangge to question him. The prince said, "The emperor has only one son, and I am his heir—what could I possibly gain by such a plot!
units.literal: When the crown prince was falsely accused, the emperor sent Yangge to interrogate him; the prince said to Yangge, "The emperor has only me as a son; I am now heir apparent—what more could I seek that I would dare do such a thing!

units.zh: 公與我為昆弟行，當念無辜，達意於帝。」
units.en: We stand as brothers in rank—think of my innocence and plead my case to the emperor."
units.literal: You and I are as brothers in rank; you ought to think of my innocence and convey my meaning to the emperor."

units.zh: 禱之甚懇。
units.en: He begged him with desperate earnestness.
units.literal: He prayed to him most earnestly.

units.zh: 蕭十三聞之，謂燕哥曰：「宜以太子言易為伏狀。」
units.en: When Xiao Shisan heard of this he told Yangge, "Twist the prince's words into a confession."
units.literal: Xiao Shisan heard of it and said to Yangge, "You ought to turn the crown prince's words into a confession with ease."

units.zh: 燕哥頷之，盡如所教以奏。
units.en: Yangge agreed and reported to the throne exactly as he had been taught.
units.literal: Yangge nodded assent and memorialized exactly as instructed.

units.zh: 及太子被逐，乙辛殺害忠良，多燕哥之謀，為契丹行宮都部署。
units.en: After the crown prince was banished, Yixin's slaughter of loyal officials owed much to Yangge's counsel; Yangge was made Overall Deployer of the Khitan Traveling Palace.
units.literal: When the crown prince was driven out, Yixin killed and harmed the loyal and good—much of it was Yangge's plotting—and he became Overall Deployer of the Khitan Traveling Palace.

units.zh: 五年夏，拜南府宰相，遷惕隱。
units.en: In the summer of the fifth year he was made Chancellor of the Southern Commission and then promoted to Tiyin.
units.literal: In the summer of the fifth year he was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Commission and transferred to Tiyin.

units.zh: 大安三年，為西京留守，致仕。
units.en: In the third year of Da'an he became Military Governor of the Western Capital, then retired from office.
units.literal: In the third year of Da'an he served as Military Governor of the Western Capital and then retired.

units.zh: 壽隆初，以疾卒。
units.en: Early in the Shoulong era he died of illness.
units.literal: At the beginning of Shoulong he died of illness.

units.zh: 蕭十三，蔑古乃部人。
units.en: Xiao Shisan came from the Miegunai Division.
units.literal: Xiao Shisan was a man of the Miegunai Division.

units.zh: 父鐸魯斡，歷官節度使。
units.en: His father Duolugun had served as Military Commissioner.
units.literal: His father Duolugun had served in office as Military Commissioner.

units.zh: 十三辨黠，善揣摩人意。
units.en: Shisan was clever and shrewd, adept at reading what others wished to hear.
units.literal: Shisan was discerning and sharp, skilled at reading people's intentions.

units.zh: 清寧間，以年勞遷護衛太保。
units.en: During Qingning he was promoted to Guards Commissioner on the strength of long service.
units.literal: During Qingning, on account of years of service he was transferred to Guards Commissioner.

units.zh: 大康初，耶律乙辛復入樞府，益橫恣。
units.en: At the start of Dakang, Yelü Yixin returned to the Commissioner's Office and grew more domineering than ever.
units.literal: At the beginning of Dakang, Yelü Yixin again entered the Commissioner's Office and grew still more overbearing and unrestrained.

units.zh: 時十三出入乙辛家，以朝臣不附者輒使出之，十三由宿衛遷殿前副點檢。
units.en: Shisan was constantly at Yixin's house; any courtier who would not join their faction was promptly posted away, and Shisan rose from palace guard to Associate Commissioner of the Palace Front Office.
units.literal: At that time Shisan went in and out of Yixin's house; whenever court ministers did not attach themselves to him he would have them sent out, and Shisan rose from palace guard duty to Associate Commissioner of the Palace Front Office.

units.zh: 三年夏，護衛蕭忽古等謀殺乙辛，事覺下獄。
units.en: In the summer of the third year the guardsman Xiao Hugu and others plotted to assassinate Yixin; when the plot was discovered they were thrown into prison.
units.literal: In the summer of the third year the guardsmen Xiao Hugu and others plotted to kill Yixin; the affair came to light and they were imprisoned.

units.zh: 十三謂乙辛曰：「今太子猶在，臣民屬心。
units.en: Shisan told Yixin, "The crown prince is still alive, and officials and commoners alike look to him.
units.literal: Shisan said to Yixin, "The crown prince still lives, and officials and people look to him in their hearts.

units.zh: 大王素無根柢之助，復有誣皇后之怨。
units.en: Your Highness has never had a firm base of support, and you still bear the grudge of having framed the empress.
units.literal: Your Highness from of old has had no deep-rooted support, and moreover bears the resentment of having framed the empress.

units.zh: 若太子立，王置身何地？
units.en: If the crown prince succeeds to the throne, where will that leave Your Highness?
units.literal: If the crown prince is established, where will Your Highness place himself?

units.zh: 宜熟計之。」
units.en: You must think this through carefully."
units.literal: You ought to think it through carefully."

units.zh: 乙辛曰：「吾憂此久矣！」
units.en: Yixin replied, "I have worried about that for a long time!"
units.literal: Yixin said, "I have worried about this for a long time!"

units.zh: 是夜，召蕭得裏特謀所以構太子事。
units.en: That very night he summoned Xiao Delite to plot how to frame the crown prince.
units.literal: That night he summoned Xiao Delite to plot how to frame the crown prince.

units.zh: 十三計既行，尋遷殿前都點檢，兼同知樞密院事。
units.en: Once Shisan's scheme succeeded, he was soon promoted to Commissioner of the Palace Front Office and made Associate Administrator of the Commissioner's Office as well.
units.literal: Once Shisan's plan had been carried out, he was soon transferred to Commissioner of the Palace Front Office and concurrently Associate Administrator of the Commissioner's Office.

units.zh: 復令蕭訛都斡等誣首耶律查剌前告耶律撒剌等事皆實，詔究其事。
units.en: He again had Xiao Eduo and others confess falsely that Yelü Chala's earlier charge against Yelü Sala and his associates had been true, and the emperor ordered a full inquiry.
units.literal: He again had Xiao Eduo and the rest lodge a false confession that Yelü Chala's earlier accusation against Yelü Sala and the rest was all true, and an edict ordered investigation of the affair.

units.zh: 太子不服，別遣夷離畢耶律燕哥問太子，太子具陳所以見誣之狀。
units.en: The crown prince protested his innocence, so Yilibi Yelü Yangge was sent to question him; the prince laid out in detail how he had been framed.
units.literal: The crown prince would not submit; separately Yilibi Yelü Yangge was sent to question the crown prince, and the prince set forth in full the circumstances of how he had been falsely accused.

units.zh: 十三聞之，謂燕哥曰：「如此奏，則大事去矣，當易其辭為伏款。」
units.en: When Shisan heard of this he told Yangge, "Report it that way and the whole scheme collapses—you must turn his words into a confession."
units.literal: Shisan heard of it and said to Yangge, "If you memorialize in this way, the great affair will be lost; you ought to change his words into a confession of guilt."

units.zh: 燕哥入，如十三言奏之。
units.en: Yangge went in and reported exactly as Shisan had instructed.
units.literal: Yangge entered and memorialized as Shisan had said.

units.zh: 上大怒，廢太子。
units.en: The emperor flew into a rage and deposed the crown prince.
units.literal: The emperor was greatly enraged and deposed the crown prince.

units.zh: 太子將出，曰：「我何罪至是！」
units.en: As the crown prince was led away he cried, "What crime have I committed to deserve this!"
units.literal: As the crown prince was about to go out, he said, "What crime have I committed to come to this!"

units.zh: 十三叱令登車，遣衛卒闔車門。
units.en: Shisan shouted at him to get into the carriage and had guardsmen slam the door shut.
units.literal: Shisan shouted at him to mount the carriage and sent guardsmen to shut the carriage door.

units.zh: 是年，遷北院樞密副使，復陳陰害太子計，乙辛從之。
units.en: That year he was made Associate Commissioner of the Northern Commissioner's Office; he again proposed a secret plot against the crown prince, and Yixin agreed.
units.literal: That year he was transferred to Associate Commissioner of the Northern Commissioner's Office; he again set forth a secret plan to harm the crown prince, and Yixin followed it.

units.zh: 及乙辛出知南院大王事，亦出十三為保州統軍使，卒。
units.en: When Yixin was transferred to Grand Prince of the Southern Commission, Shisan was posted away as Military Commander of Baozhou, where he died.
units.literal: When Yixin was sent out to serve as Grand Prince of the Southern Commission, Shisan was also sent out as Military Commander of Baozhou and died there.

units.zh: 乾統間，剖棺戮屍。
units.en: During the Qiantong era his coffin was opened and his corpse was publicly shamed.
units.literal: During Qiantong his coffin was opened and his corpse was disgraced.

units.zh: 二子：的裏得、念經，皆伏誅。
units.en: His two sons, Dilede and Nianjing, were both executed.
units.literal: His two sons, Dilede and Nianjing, both submitted to execution.

units.zh: 又，案《五代會要》所載，內職有梁太祖昭儀陳氏、昭容李氏，《歐陽史》並見《家人傳》。）〉
units.en: The 《Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium》 also lists the Founder’s Lady of Bright Deportment Chen and Lady of Bright Countenance Li, both noted in Ouyang Xiu’s 《New History》 Family section.)〉
units.literal: Moreover, examining what the 《Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium》 records, among inner offices were the Founder’s Lady of Bright Deportment Chen and Lady of Bright Countenance Li; both appear in 《Ouyang’s History》 in the Family Biographies.)〉

units.zh: 案《歐陽史次妃郭氏傳》云：晉天福三年，詔太社先藏罪人首級，許親屬收葬，乃出末帝首，遣右衛將軍安崇阮與妃同葬。
units.en: Ouyang’s 《History》 biography of Consort Guo notes that in Tianfu 3 Jin permitted families to claim criminals’ heads from the Grand Altar; the Last Emperor’s head was released and General An Chongruan buried it with his consort.
units.literal: Examining 《Ouyang’s History》, in the biography of the second consort Guo it says: In Jin Tianfu year 3 an edict allowed kin to bury heads of criminals long stored at the Grand Altar; the Last Emperor’s head was produced, and Right Palace Guard general An Chongruan was sent to bury it together with the consort.

units.zh: 漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華。
units.en: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.
units.literal: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.

units.zh: 戊戌，皇子宗真生。
units.en: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.
units.literal: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.

units.zh: 己卯，封皇子重元秦國王。
units.en: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.
units.literal: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.

units.zh: 㥄素與魏收不協，收既專典國史，㥄恐被惡言，乃悅之曰：「昔有班固，今則魏子。」
units.en: Ling had long been at odds with Wei Shou; once Shou came to monopolize the national history, Ling feared slander and flattered him, saying, "In old times there was Ban Gu; today there is Master Wei."
units.literal: Ling had long been at odds with Wei Shou; once Shou came to monopolize the national history, Ling feared slander and therefore flattered him, saying: "In old times there was Ban Gu; today there is Master Wei."

units.zh: 十二月辛未，以知北院樞密使事耶律宜新為中京留守，南院宣徽使耶律撒剌為南院大王。
units.en: On xinwei day of the twelfth month Yelü Yixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made regent of the Central Capital; Southern Court palace commissioner Yelü Sala was made Southern Court great king.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on xinwei day Yelü Yixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made regent of the Central Capital; Southern Court palace commissioner Yelü Sala Southern Court great king.

units.zh: 癸未，殺始平軍節度使撒剌等十人，又遣使殺上京留守速撒，及已徙護衛撒撥等六人。
units.en: On guimao day ten including Shiping Army military commissioner Sala were killed; envoys were also dispatched to kill Supreme Capital regent Susa and the six exiled guards including Sapo.
units.literal: On guimao day killed ten including Shiping Army military commissioner Sala; also dispatched envoys to kill Supreme Capital regent Susa and the six exiled guards including Sapo.

units.zh: 六月己卯朔，耶律乙辛令牌印郎君蕭訛都斡誣首嘗預速撒等謀，籍其姓名以告。
units.en: On the jimao new moon of the sixth month Yelü Yixin ordered seal-and-tally langjun Xiao Eduwo to falsely accuse and say he had once joined Susa and the others in the plot, registering names to report.
units.literal: Sixth month, on jimao new moon, Yelü Yixin ordered seal-and-tally langjun Xiao Eduwo to falsely accuse and say he had once joined Susa and the others in the plot, registering names to report.

units.zh: 秋七月辛亥，護衛太保查剌加鎮國大將軍，預突呂不部節度使之選，室韋查剌及蕭寶神奴、謀魯古並加左衛大將軍，牌印郎君訛都斡尚皇女趙國公主，授駙馬都尉、始平軍節度使，祗候郎君耶律撻不也及蕭圖古辭並加監門衛上將軍。
units.en: On xinhai day of the seventh autumn month Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala was promoted Pacifying State grand general and hereditary in selection for Tielübu tribal military commissioner; Shiwei Zhala and Xiao Baoshennu and Molugu were all promoted Left Guard grand generals; seal-and-tally langjun Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao, was appointed imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Shiping Army; attendant langjun Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Tuguci were both promoted Defender of the Gate Commandant upper generals.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala was promoted Pacifying State grand general and hereditary in selection for Tielübu tribal military commissioner; Shiwei Zhala and Xiao Baoshennu and Molugu were all promoted Left Guard grand generals; seal-and-tally langjun Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao, appointed imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Shiping Army; attendant langjun Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Tuguci were both promoted Defender of the Gate Commandant upper generals.

units.zh: 如耶律撻不也、蕭達魯古等，黨人之尤凶狡者，皆以賂免。
units.en: Men such as Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Dalugu, the faction's most vicious members, all bought their way free.
units.literal: Such men as Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Dalugu — the most vicious and cunning of the faction — all escaped through bribery.

units.zh: 至二年，始廢乙辛等墓，剖棺戮屍，誅其子孫，餘黨子孫減死，徙邊，其家屬奴婢皆分賜被害之家。
units.en: In the second year Yixin's tomb was destroyed, his coffin opened and corpse flogged, his descendants executed; other faction members' descendants had sentences reduced and were exiled, their families and slaves given to the victims' kin.
units.literal: By the second year, Yixin's tomb and others were at last destroyed, coffins opened and corpses flogged, his descendants executed; descendants of the remaining faction had death reduced and were moved to the border; their household members and slaves were all distributed as gifts to the families of the victims.

units.zh: 己丑，以南院樞密使蕭阿速為北府宰相，樞密副使耶律乙辛南院樞密使，惕隱查葛遼興軍節度使，魯王謝家奴武定軍節度使，東京留守吳王貼不西京留守。
units.en: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.
units.literal: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.

units.zh: 以耶律乙辛知北院樞密使事。
units.en: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
units.literal: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.

units.zh: 皇子洪基生。
units.en: The imperial prince Hongji was born.
units.literal: The imperial prince Hongji was born.

units.zh: 戊寅，契丹阿保機遣使貢良馬。
units.en: On wuyin Abaoji sent fine horses as tribute.
units.literal: On wuyin the Khitan Abaoji sent envoys presenting fine horses.

units.zh: 古者舉賢不避親仇，如祁奚舉仇，仁傑舉子，崔祐甫除吏八百皆親故也。
units.en: Antiquity knew no such scruple: Qi Xi recommended his enemy, Di Renjie recommended his son, and Cui Youfu appointed eight hundred relatives and associates.
units.literal: In antiquity recommending the worthy did not avoid kin or enemies, as Qi Xi recommending his enemy, Renjie recommending his son, Cui Youfu appointing eight hundred officials all kin and associates.

units.zh: 十二月丁卯朔，遣耶律遂英、王永錫充賀宋太后生辰，蕭速撒、馬保永充賀正旦使副。
units.en: On the dingmao new moon of the twelfth month Yelü Suiying and Wang Yongxi were dispatched as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Xiao Susa and Ma Baoyong as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the dingmao new moon, dispatched Yelü Suiying and Wang Yongxi as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Xiao Susa and Ma Baoyong as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

units.zh: 鐸穩。
units.en: Duowen.
units.literal: Duowen.

units.zh: 右係出德祖宣簡皇帝。
units.en: Right descent line from Emperor Dezu the Proclaimed and Simple.
units.literal: Right descent line from Emperor Dezu the Proclaimed and Simple.

units.zh: 乙亥，北院樞密使耶律乙辛奏，右護衛太保查剌等告知北院樞密使事蕭速撒等八人謀立皇太子，上以無狀，不治，出速撒等三人補外，護衛撒撥等六人各鞭百餘，徙於邊。
units.en: On yihai day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin memorialized that Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala and others reported that associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Susa and eight others plotted to install the crown prince; the Emperor said it was groundless and did not punish; three including Susa were sent out to fill external posts; six including guard Sapo were each flogged more than a hundred strokes and exiled to the border.
units.literal: On yihai day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin memorialized that Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala and others reported that associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Susa and eight others plotted to install the crown prince; the Emperor said it was groundless and did not punish; three including Susa were sent out to fill external posts; six including guard Sapo were each flogged more than a hundred strokes and exiled to the border.

units.zh: 下嫁蕭末。下嫁蕭末 紀大康二年六月作蕭霞抹。
units.en: She was given in marriage to Xiao Mo; the annals for the sixth month of Dakang year 2 write Xiao Xiamo.
units.literal: Given in marriage to Xiao Mo—per the annals, in the sixth month of Dakang year 2 this is written Xiao Xiamo.

units.zh: 六月戊寅朔，以蕭寧、耶律坦、崔禹稱、馬世良、耶律仁先、劉六符充賀宋生辰使副；
units.en: On the wuyin new moon of the sixth month Xiao Ning, Yelü Tan, Cui Yucheng, Ma Shiliang, Yelü Renxian, and Liu Liufu were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays;
units.literal: Sixth month, on the wuyin new moon, appointed Xiao Ning, Yelü Tan, Cui Yucheng, Ma Shiliang, Yelü Renxian, and Liu Liufu chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays;

units.zh: 辛卯，仁先、劉六符還，進宋國誓書。
units.en: On xinmao day Renxian and Liu Liufu returned and presented the Song State oath document.
units.literal: On xinmao day, Renxian and Liu Liufu returned and presented the Song State oath document.

units.zh: 十年春正月辛亥朔，宋遣梁適、張從一、富弼、趙日宣來賀。
units.en: In the tenth year, on the xinhai new moon of the first spring month Song sent Liang Shi, Zhang Congyi, Fu Bi, and Zhao Rixuan with congratulations.
units.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on the xinhai new moon, Song dispatched Liang Shi, Zhang Congyi, Fu Bi, and Zhao Rixuan to come congratulate.

units.zh: 十一年春正月戊申，奉迎皇太后於內殿。
units.en: In the eleventh year, on wushen day of the first spring month the Empress Dowager was escorted into the inner hall.
units.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, on wushen day, escorted the Empress Dowager into the inner hall.

units.zh: 九月壬寅，遣北院樞密副使耶律仁先、漢人行宮副部署劉六符使宋約和。
units.en: On renyin day of the ninth month Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian and Han traveling palace deputy deployment director Liu Liufu were dispatched as envoys to Song to negotiate peace.
units.literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, dispatched Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian and Han traveling palace deputy deployment director Liu Liufu as envoys to Song to negotiate peace.

units.zh: 閏月癸未，耶律仁先遣人報，宋歲增銀、絹十萬兩、匹，文書稱貢，送至白溝；
units.en: On guiwei day of the intercalary month Yelü Renxian dispatched a messenger reporting that Song's annual tribute was increased by one hundred thousand taels of silver and bolts of silk, the documents called it tribute, and it was delivered to Baigou;
units.literal: Intercalary month, on guiwei day, Yelü Renxian dispatched a messenger reporting that Song's annual tribute was increased by one hundred thousand taels of silver and bolts of silk, the documents called it tribute, delivered to Baigou;

units.zh: 十二年春正月辛未，遣同知析津府事耶律敵烈、樞密院都承旨王惟吉諭夏國與宋和。
units.en: In the twelfth year, on xinwei day of the first spring month Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji were dispatched to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.
units.literal: Twelfth year, spring, first month, on xinwei day, dispatched Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.

units.zh: 壬申，以吳國王蕭孝穆為南院樞密使，北府宰相蕭孝忠北院樞密使，封楚王，韓國王蕭惠北府宰相、同知元帥府事，韓八南院大王，耶律侯哂東京留守，北院樞密副使耶律仁先同知東京留守事，北面林牙蕭革北院樞密副使。
units.en: On renshen day Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Southern Privy Commissioner; Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaozhong was made Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Chu; Prince of Han Xiao Hui was made Northern Chancellor and co-administrator of the marshal headquarters; Han Ba was made Southern Court great king; Yelü Houshen was appointed Eastern Capital regent; Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian was made co-administrator of Eastern Capital regent affairs; and Northern Court linya Xiao Ge was appointed Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.
units.literal: On renshen day, made Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu Southern Privy Commissioner, Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaozhong Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Chu, Prince of Han Xiao Hui Northern Chancellor and co-administrator of the marshal headquarters, Han Ba Southern Court great king, Yelü Houshen Eastern Capital regent, Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian co-administrator of Eastern Capital regent affairs, Northern Court linya Xiao Ge Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.

units.zh: 是年，禦清涼殿放進士張孝傑等四十四人。
units.en: That year, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Zhang Xiaojie and forty-four others were passed.
units.literal: That year, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Zhang Xiaojie and forty-four others were passed.

units.zh: 十二月庚寅，以北大王府布猥帳郎君自言先世與國聯姻，許置敞史，命本帳蕭胡睹為之。
units.en: On gengyin day of the twelfth month, because a langjun of the Northern Great King Household's Buwei Account claimed ancestral marriage ties with the dynasty, permission was granted to establish a chanshi, and Xiao Hudu of that account was appointed to the post.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on gengyin day, because a Northern Great King Household Buwei Account langjun claimed his ancestors had intermarried with the state, permission was granted to establish a chanshi; Xiao Hudu of his account was ordered to fill the post.

units.zh: 即命乙辛及耶律仲禧、蕭餘里也、耶律孝傑、楊遵勖、燕哥、抄只、蕭十三等鞫治，杖皇太子，囚之宮中。
units.en: Yixin and Yelü Zhongxi, Xiao Yuliye, Yelü Xiaojie, Yang Zunxu, Yange, Chaozhi, Xiao Shisan, and others were immediately ordered to investigate; the crown prince was beaten and imprisoned in the palace.
units.literal: Immediately ordered Yixin and Yelü Zhongxi, Xiao Yuliye, Yelü Xiaojie, Yang Zunxu, Yange, Chaozhi, Xiao Shisan, and others to investigate; the crown prince was beaten and imprisoned in the palace.

units.zh: 乙辛尋遣達魯古、撒八往害之，太子年方二十，上京留守蕭撻得紿以疾薨聞。
units.en: Yixin soon sent Dalugu and Saba to kill him. The crown prince was only twenty; Upper Capital regent Xiao Tade was tricked with a report that he had died of illness.
units.literal: Yixin soon sent Dalugu and Saba to go and harm him; the crown prince was only twenty years old; the Upper Capital regent Xiao Tade was deceived with a report that he had died of illness.

units.zh: 閏十二月戊午，以北府宰相遼西郡王蕭餘里也知北院樞密使事，左夷離畢耶律燕哥為契丹行宮都部署。
units.en: In the intercalary twelfth month, on wuwu day Northern Court chancellor Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Yange was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
units.literal: Intercalary twelfth month, on wuwu day Northern Court chancellor Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Yange Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

units.zh: 耶律乙辛謀害太子，撻不也知其奸，欲殺乙辛及蕭特裏得、蕭十三等。
units.en: When Yelu Yixin plotted against the crown prince, Tabuye saw through his treachery and meant to kill Yixin along with Xiao Telide, Xiao Shisan, and their faction.
units.literal: Yelu Yixin plotted to harm the Crown Prince; Tabuye knew his treachery and wished to kill Yixin together with Xiao Telide, Xiao Shisan, and others.

units.zh: 大康三年，復欲殺乙辛及蕭得裏特等，乙辛知而械系之。
units.en: In the third year of Dakang he again plotted to kill Yixin and Xiao Delite; Yixin learned of it and had him arrested in fetters.
units.literal: In the third year of Dakang, he again wished to kill Yixin and Xiao Delite and others; Yixin learned of it and had him shackled and bound.

units.zh: 如蕭得裏特實乙辛之黨，耶律合魯亦不為早辨，賴陛下之明，遂正其事。
units.en: Xiao Delite was truly of Yixin's party, and Yelu Helu failed to expose this in time; only Your Majesty's discernment set the matter right.
units.literal: For example, Xiao Delite was in truth of Yixin's faction, and Yelu Helu also did not distinguish the matter early; relying on Your Majesty's clarity, the affair was then set right.

units.zh: 天祚即位，召為御史中丞。
units.en: When Emperor Tianzuo acceded he was recalled as Vice Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: When Tianzuo took the throne, he was summoned as Vice Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 甲申，詔北院樞密使魏王耶律乙辛同母兄大奴、同母弟阿思世預北、南院樞密之選，其異母諸弟世預夷離堇之選。
units.en: On jiashen day an edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.
units.literal: On jiashen day, edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.

units.zh: 流林牙蕭巖壽於烏隗部。
units.en: Linya Xiao Yanshou was exiled to the Wuhui tribe.
units.literal: Linya Xiao Yanshou was exiled to the Wuhui tribe.

units.zh: 會護衛蕭忽古謀害乙辛，事覺，下獄。
units.en: When guard Xiao Hugu plotted to kill Yixin, the plot was exposed and he was thrown into prison.
units.literal: It happened that guard Xiao Hugu plotted to kill Yixin; the affair was discovered and he was cast into prison.

units.zh: 乃與同知北院宣徽事蕭特裏特謀構陷太子，陰令右護衛太保耶律查剌誣告都宮使耶律撒剌、知院蕭速撒、護衛蕭忽古謀廢立。
units.en: He and Associate Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of Palace Attendants Xiao Telite then plotted to frame the crown prince, secretly ordering Right Guard Commissioner Yelü Chala to accuse Palace Director Yelü Sala, Commissioner Xiao Susa, and guard Xiao Hugu of plotting a coup.
units.literal: He then joined Associate Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of Palace Attendants Xiao Telite in plotting to frame the crown prince, secretly ordering Right Guard Commissioner Yelü Chala to accuse falsely Palace Director Yelü Sala, Commissioner Xiao Susa, and guard Xiao Hugu of plotting deposition and installation.

units.zh: 乙巳，以北府宰相蕭兀納為遼興軍節度使，加守太傅。
units.en: On yisi day Northern Court chancellor Xiao Wuna was made military commissioner of Liaoxing Army and promoted Defender of the State grand mentor.
units.literal: On yisi day Northern Court chancellor Xiao Wuna was made military commissioner of Liaoxing Army and promoted Defender of the State grand mentor.

units.zh: 乙辛欲害太子，以達魯古凶果可使，遣與近侍直長撒把詣上京，同留守蕭撻得夜引力士至囚室，紿以有赦，召太子出，殺之，函其首以歸，詐云疾薨。
units.en: When Yixin wished to kill the crown prince, he judged Dalugu cruel and resolute enough for the task; he sent him with Inner Attendant Direct Chief Saba to the Upper Capital, where together with the acting commander Xiao Tade they led strongmen by night to the prison chamber, deceived the prince with word of an amnesty, called him out and killed him, boxed his head and returned, and falsely reported that he had died of sudden illness.
units.literal: Wanting to harm the crown prince, Yixin deemed Dalugu cruel and resolute enough for the task; he dispatched him with Inner Attendant Direct Chief Saba to the Upper Capital, where together with the acting commander Xiao Tade they led strongmen by night to the prison chamber, deceived the prince with word of an amnesty, summoned him out, killed him, boxed his head and returned, falsely reporting that he had died of sudden illness.
